issue: 김장철 막힘·냄새 없는 주방 배수구 관리법
angle: 참치캔 배수구 꿀팁 기사에서 착안, 김장철 양념·배추 찌꺼기로 배수구가 막히고 냄새나기 쉬운 시기라 골랐어요
title: 냄새·막힘 싹 잡는
주방 배수구 관리법 7
subtitle: 설거지 끝, 배수구는 못 본 척하셨죠?
scene: A bright Korean home kitchen in warm morning sunlight from a window on the left; the hero object is a stainless steel kitchen sink with a round stainless drain strainer basket in the center, white matte quartz countertop around it, a small green plant and a ceramic soap dish near the window, soft natural light, clean and cozy, lower third of the frame is simple plain countertop surface
cover_image_prompt: Close-up of the gleaming stainless steel sink with a spotless round drain strainer in focus, water droplets sparkling in the morning sun, plain white countertop in the lower third, no text, no faces

tips.title: 거름망은 매일 비우기
lines: 썩기 전에 버려야 냄새가 안 나요
tips.image_prompt: A hand lifting the drain strainer basket and tipping food scraps into a small food waste bag beside the sink

tips.title: 기름은 닦고 설거지
tips.image_prompt: A hand wiping an oily frying pan with a paper towel next to the sink before washing

tips.title: 김장 땐 망 덧대기
tips.image_prompt: A fine mesh disposable net being fitted over the strainer basket, a bowl with napa cabbage leaves nearby

tips.title: 베이킹소다 거품 청소
tips.image_prompt: A measuring cup of baking soda and a cup of vinegar on the counter, gentle white foam bubbling in the sink drain

tips.title: 마무리는 뜨거운 물
tips.note: 펄펄 끓는 물은 배관이 상할 수 있어요
tips.image_prompt: A kettle pouring steaming warm water into the drain, light steam rising in the sunlight

tips.title: 거름망은 칫솔로
tips.image_prompt: A hand scrubbing the stainless strainer basket with an old toothbrush under running water

tips.title: 밤엔 덮개 닫기
lines: 자기 전 배수구 덮개를 꼭 닫아요
tips.image_prompt: A hand placing a round stainless drain cover over the clean drain, evening-calm tidy sink

warning.title: 이건 절대 하지 마세요
warning.image_prompt: On the same countertop, a bleach bottle and a vinegar bottle set apart from each other, and a jar of used cooking oil next to the sink, no labels or text

caption:
배수구 냄새, 세제만 바꾸면 되는 줄 알았어요 😅
알고 보니 거름망 매일 비우기가 제일 중요하더라고요.
팬 기름은 키친타월로 먼저 닦고, 김장 땐 촘촘한 망을 하나 덧대 주세요.
베이킹소다 반 컵에 식초 1컵, 30분 뒤 따뜻한 물로 헹구면 미끈한 때가 쑥 빠져요.
락스와 식초는 절대 섞지 마세요!
여러분은 배수구 청소, 얼마나 자주 하세요?
